title: Typed IR implementation mapping
summary: Accepted typed in-memory Document IR for Badge inline calls and generic Alert block components.
current_behavior: DocumentParser emits immutable MarkdownNode and SmartCallNode objects with line-range SourceSpan values.
A block resolver registry and a renderer registry fail closed for unknown registered types.
Headings and links are separately inspected for metadata.
Ordinary Markdown is still passed as one coarse string to PortableMarkdownRenderer.
M2 adds a 35-node typed in-memory IR for Badge with heading, paragraph, table, code_block, example and component types plus physical file/line/column provenance.
The Badge IR is serialized only as a test fixture; the public build emits no mandatory page IR JSON or JSONL.
M3.2 adds one generic component_block node with typed children, props and exact source spans, including blocks inside fenced Markdown examples.
Alert uses five generic block nodes and no Alert-specific IR type.
Batch 07 adds generic list and blockquote source nodes with exact ranges; both reuse SourceDocumentNodeRenderer.
Batch 08 adds one generic image SourceNode with exact location and reuses SourceDocumentNodeRenderer; table/example markup remains one shared renderer path.
Batch 09 reuses generic code_block and example nodes; nested source fences and footnote anchors remain inside the same shared Markdown renderer contract.

Batch 10 adds one generic typed_directive SourceNode with canonical component and renderer ids, props and exact ranges for all admitted catalog directives; Details and empty Backlinks use the same node and renderer-registry entry.
Batch 11 reuses that same typed_directive node for Banner and Download without adding component-specific compiler or renderer paths.
Batch 12 routes Badge, Button, Icon and Kbd through one manifest-owned inline ComponentNode contract and the existing renderer registry/Smart gateway; no component-specific IR type remains.
Batch 13 reuses the generic typed_directive node for Card and Hero with no family-specific compiler, IR or renderer-registry path.
Batch 14 reuses the generic typed_directive node for Grid and Figure with no layout/media-specific compiler, IR or renderer registry.
Batch 15 reuses the generic typed_directive node for Media and Logos with no media/logo-specific compiler, IR or renderer registry.
Batch 16 reuses the generic typed_directive node for Diagram and Math with no technical-content-specific compiler, IR or renderer registry.

Batch 17 reuses the generic typed_directive node for Code-from-file and HTML; the shared example renderer carries source context for nested external-code previews without adding a component-specific path.
Batch 18 reuses generic typed_directive and example nodes for consent-gated Embed and interactive Example without adding family-specific compiler, IR, registry or gateway paths.

Batch 19 reuses generic typed_directive nodes for Steps and Tree; accessible Tree interaction lives in the shared declarative shell without a family-specific compiler, IR, registry, gateway or PageBuilder.
known_deviations: The current AST can be serialized in receipts, but the target permits no mandatory page-level JSON/JSONL.

Typed native node coverage now includes Badge, Button, Icon, Kbd, Alert, headings/text, lists/quotes, links/images, table, code, external code, isolated HTML, Embed, Example, footnotes/sources, Details, Backlinks, Banner, Download, Card, Hero, Grid, Figure, Media, Logos, Diagram, Math, Steps, Tree and Syntax; remaining generated routes retain the rollback adapter.
The earlier declarative SourceSpan remains separate from the target SourceLocation.
PortableMarkdownRenderer remains active for non-Badge routes until bounded M3 parity evidence exists.
deletion_gates: Delete MarkdownNode only after typed block/inline coverage and exact badge parity.
Retire PortableMarkdownRenderer component logic only after every moved node renderer has positive, negative and source-location tests.
Delete duplicate metadata parsing only after headings and links are derived from the canonical IR.
